root_cause.summary: Deploy d-0151 (1.15.0) switched FEATURE_FAST_CHECKOUT on; the new fast-checkout totals path throws a TypeError for EUR carts only, so EUR checkouts fail with 500 while USD/GBP succeed.

evidence.quote: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'currency')

ruled_out.why: cron overran already at 09:15 before the deploy; rps and db_pool_in_use are flat; only EUR fails
db pool ok active=8 of max=20; DB_POOL_MAX is 20 in config loaded

proposed_action.step: A. PR setting FEATURE_FAST_CHECKOUT=false in config/prod.env (or roll back d-0151 by on-call)

open: Why does fastCheckout.totals lose the currency for EUR? Needs a code fix + test before re-enabling the flag.
